comment: 27yo female, recently confirmed germline CDH1 c.1003C>T truncating variant on multi-gene panel after father diagnosed with linitis plastica diffuse-type gastric cancer at age 41 (deceased; signet ring cell histology); paternal aunt diagnosed with invasive lobular breast cancer at age 49. Patient unaffected — no current gastric or breast cancer. HDGC carriers: lifetime diffuse-type gastric cancer ~37-42% (female), invasive lobular breast cancer ~37-55% (female) per IGCLC 2020. Fires RF-HDGC-CDH1-CONFIRMED-CARRIER (relevant_diseases: gastric, breast). Engine routes to PreventionPlan: default = IND-HDGC-CDH1-CARRIER-PREVENTION-SURVEILLANCE (prophylactic total gastrectomy discussion ages 20-30 per IGCLC 2020 + BRCA-style breast surveillance from age 30); alternative = IND-HDGC-CDH1-CARRIER-PREVENTION-OBSERVATION (endoscopic surveillance for PTG-declining carriers — acknowledged inferior + breast surveillance).
